N01: Mamá gently smooths the blanket with her trunk and softly pats it; the baby elephant smiles and slowly blinks; the camera stays still. Both faces stay exactly the same, calm small movements.
N04: He slowly looks left and then right with only his eyes, then pulls the blanket up a little higher with his hands; his face stays the same, his eyes stay above the blanket; the camera stays still.
N06: Mamá gently wiggles the plush giraffe left and right and the big giraffe shadow on the wall wiggles the same way at the same time; the baby elephant smiles; the plush giraffe keeps its small button eyes; the camera stays still.
K1: He keeps sitting on the bed, raises his trunk high and trumpets, sways his head gently with joy and waves his little arms; the plush giraffe stays still beside him; his face and eyes stay the same; he stays seated on the bed the whole time; the camera stays still.
K3: He breathes in slowly and his tummy and shoulders rise, then he breathes out slowly and relaxes; his eyes stay gently closed the whole time; his head stays facing the camera; the camera stays still.
K4: He sleeps peacefully; the blanket rises and falls slowly with his breathing; his eyes stay closed the whole time; he snuggles a little deeper into the pillow; the camera stays still.
N13: He presses the button with his thumb and a bright cone of light shines out of the flashlight forward and down onto the floor; he leans forward bravely; his trunk stays curled up and separate from the flashlight; the camera stays still.
N14: The flashlight beam slides slowly across the floor and lands on the toy truck; its two headlights twinkle softly; the truck does not move; the camera stays still.
N15: He waves goodnight slowly with one hand, gives a small soft yawn with his mouth only a little open, and his eyes slowly close; the toys stay still in his arms; the camera stays still.
